domain: CROP WINDOWS + CROP CALENDAR + PREPARATION CLOCK
summary: Two screens live here. (A) view 'windows' (markup 535-751) is NOT a window list at all — it is the CROP CALENDAR: a rolling month timeline whose rows, dates, phenology bands, hectares, per-region date offsets and observed-stage dots ALL come from the demo fixtures D.CROP_CAL (8 crops, 40 crop x region rows) and D.OBSERVED (10 rows). The canonical contract is never consulted on this screen. (B) view 'window' (markup 752-810) is the window detail, fed by D.WINDOWS[29], a fixture that wraps each canonical window in ~20 decorated fields (prep, bucket, early, why, readiness, ladder, scale, kind) that have no upstream equivalent. Measured reality: CANONICAL supplies 29 windows with crop/issue/region/windowType/status/statusReason/dateState/dateConfidence 29/29, START_DATE and END_DATE 24/29, and NOTHING else — CROP_STAGE 0/29, ISSUE_STAGE 0/29, GENERATION_OR_STAGE 0/29, LABEL_TRIGGER 0/29, REGULATORY_TIMING 0/29, PRODUCT_MATCHES empty 29/29, SOURCE_IDS empty 29/29. IG.CROP_WINDOWS[7] carries the only real regulatory acts (5 grapevine Flavescenza rows) and the only two real observed stages (both Modena province). ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS supplies 12 VERIFIED crop x issue x product tuples covering 11 of 29 windows. Everything else on both screens is fixture.
realSource: Primary: APP.collections.windows (29 records, provenance CANONICAL, from window.ITALY_CANONICAL.windows). Secondary, currently NOT exposed by the model and must be added: window.ITALY_INGEST.CROP_WINDOWS (7 records — 5 grapevine Flavescenza rows with REGULATORY_ACT / REGULATORY_WINDOW / MONITORING_WINDOW / APPLICATION_WINDOW_2026 / PREPARATION_WINDOW / COVERAGE_STATE, plus 2 Modena field-observation rows that are the only OBSERVED_STAGE values in the whole pack) and window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (12 VERIFIED tuples, the only real product-to-window relationship). IG.CROPS[17] has NO region and NO area fields and therefore backs nothing on these screens. Coverage after migration: 29 rows over 10 crops x 9 regions (vs 40 fixture rows over 8 crops); 24/29 rows have real dates; 11/29 have a verified ADAMA product; 2/29 (Veneto, Piemonte Flavescenza) gain a real regulatory act; 0/29 have an observed crop stage.

modelChanges.why: The view must stop deriving status, dates and product links itself. Every field here is a direct copy or a rule-7-legal date arithmetic, so the calendar and the detail screen become dumb renderers.
fields: canonicalStatus — alias of status; exists purely to kill the portale.html:3004 defect where w.canonicalStatus is undefined and every product-page window reads DATE TO CONFIRM. Derivation: w.CURRENT_STATUS, 29/29 present.
open — status === 'WINDOW_OPEN'. Upstream decision only, never a date comparison. Measured 6/29 true.
hasDates — !!(START_DATE && END_DATE). Measured 24/29 true; the 5 false rows must render DATA DA CONFERMARE everywhere instead of a bar.
windowLabel — hasDates ? fmt(startDate) + ' -> ' + fmt(endDate) : null. Pure formatting of CANONICAL START_DATE/END_DATE.

observedStage / observedStageSource — from the joined IG.CROP_WINDOWS row's OBSERVED_STAGE, but ONLY when the string does not begin with 'NAO SEI' and does not contain 'nenhum boletim'. Measured: 5 of the 7 IG rows are explicit NAO SEI, and neither of the 2 real ones (Modena) matches a canonical region, so this is null 29/29 today. It exists so that the next data load lights the field up without a view change.

verifiedProducts — array of product names from ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS.VERIFIED where tuple[0] === crop and normalizeIssue(tuple[1]) === normalizeIssue(issue). normalizeIssue must fold ' / ' and ' · ' to a single separator, otherwise IT-WIN-0016 'Cereal Aphids · BYDV Risk' misses the verdict 'Cereal Aphids / BYDV Risk'. Measured with folding: 12 tuples covering 11 of 29 windows; without folding, 10 windows.

labelVerdictState — 'VERIFIED_LABEL_MATCH' when verifiedProducts.length, else 'NO_CONFIRMED_MATCH_CURRENT_READING'. Rule 10: the UI string for the second value must be 'nessuna corrispondenza confermata nella lettura attuale', never 'ADAMA has no product'.

regulatory — the joined IG.CROP_WINDOWS record, matched on normalized crop (VITE->Grapevine, OLIVO->Olive) plus exact REGION. Measured join: 2 of 29 canonical windows (IT-WIN-0001 Veneto and IT-WIN-0008 Piemonte, both Flavescenza Dorata). Fields carried through: act (REGULATORY_ACT), actState (REGULATORY_ACT_STATE), regulatoryWindow, monitoringWindow, applicationWindow2026, nextImportantWindow, preparationWindow, coverageState, sourceId. null for the other 27.
sourceIds — w.SOURCE_IDS. Measured empty 29/29. Keep the field so the view can render 'nessuna fonte collegata' instead of inventing one.
modelChanges.derivation: All from window.ITALY_CANONICAL.windows plus two joins: window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS.VERIFIED (crop + issue) and window.ITALY_INGEST.CROP_WINDOWS (crop + region). No demo read except record.ui.

modelChanges.why: The calendar screen currently builds its own 40-row universe from D.CROP_CAL. This projection makes the canonical set the row universe so the screen stops being a second source of timing truth. It is deliberately a thin re-shape of collections.windows, not a new fact store.
fields: windowId, crop, region, issue, issueType — copied.

startDate, endDate, hasDates, status, statusReason, dateState, dateConfidence — copied. dateState is the honest replacement for the fixture's 'CONFIRMED WINDOW / SEASONAL WINDOW / EXPECTED WINDOW' kind label: measured EXPECTED_NORM 24, DATE_TO_CONFIRM 5.
daysToStart, daysToEnd — already computed by daysFrom() against the single reference date 2026-09-02. Rule 6 satisfied; the calendar's own TODAY_DT already reads AM.REF.
verifiedProducts, labelVerdictState, regulatory, observedStage — copied from the extended windows record.

coverageState — three honest values derived only from what is present: 'FIELD_OBSERVED' when observedStage is non-null (0/29 today), 'REGULATORY_READ' when regulatory is non-null (2/29), else 'EXPECTED_NORM_ONLY' (27/29). This replaces the fixture's CURRENT / PARTIAL / EXPECTED ONLY which was computed from D.OBSERVED and D.SOURCES.

area / areaState — NOT PROVIDED. There is no hectare field anywhere in ITALY_INGEST (measured: 0 occurrences of any hectare key; IG.CROPS carries only product-mention counts). The '~350k ha' figures and the HIGH/MEDIUM scale label they drive must be removed, not re-derived.

expectedCycle, observedStage, fieldReportedStage — each passed through an unknownGuard() that returns null when the value starts with 'NAO SEI' or 'NÃO SEI'. Measured: expectedCycle real 5/7, observedStage real 2/7, fieldReportedStage real 2/7.
regulatoryAct, regulatoryActState, regulatoryWindow, monitoringWindow, applicationWindow2026, nextImportantWindow, preparationWindow — measured 5/7 present (all grapevine Flavescenza).
coverageState (REGULATORY_READ_FIELD_NOT_READ 5, FIELD_READ_ONE_PROVINCE_ONLY 2), notProves (WHAT_IT_DOES_NOT_PROVE, 2/7), sourceId, provenance.

risks: The screen gets visibly emptier and there is no way around it. The timeline loses the crop-cycle band, the weed band and the observed dot on every row; the region column loses its hectare line and its scale chip; the row count drops 40 -> 29; the season view loses its phase cards. What remains per row is: the canonical window bar, the preparation bar (labelled interpretation), a status chip, a date range and a product line. Rule 3 says a smaller truthful screen beats a dense fake one and rule 12 says do not redesign to compensate — the serial engineer must be told this is expected, not a bug, or the instinct will be to backfill.

Whole crops disappear from the crop rail. Wheat loses all five of its regions (no canonical Septoria window exists for Veneto, Piemonte, Lombardia, Toscana or Umbria) and Durum Wheat keeps 3 of 6. Anyone who has demoed the Wheat calendar will read this as a regression.

IG.CROP_WINDOWS free text is in Portuguese, not Italian — 'aberta — inicio de agosto a fim de setembro', 'FECHADA — as janelas obrigatorias terminaram em junho'. Piping it straight into an Italian-default UI (rule 11) would be worse than showing nothing. Either fence it as a verbatim analyst note or hold it back until the next ingest translates it.

The label-verdict join is separator-sensitive. IT-WIN-0016 'Cereal Aphids · BYDV Risk' versus the audit's 'Cereal Aphids / BYDV Risk' is the only case today, but the same class of mismatch will silently drop future matches. Normalize once in the model and never in a view.

strengthFor() and productByKey links in italy-app-model.js still route through D.CASES.productLinks (line 102). This domain does not own that path, but the window screens consume its output through wd.c.productObjs. If the products domain migrates on a different schedule, the window detail will briefly read verified products from one source and the case-derived list from another. Coordinate step 10 with whoever owns the products domain.

The upstream OPPORTUNITIES use LEGACY_CASE_ID 'IT-HERO-001..003' while canonical windows use LEGACY_CASE_ID 'IT-OPP-001..029'. There is no overlap, so the three real opportunities cannot currently be joined to a window by legacy id. Do not invent a join.
